E1.title: Missing ID
E1.cause: Every entry must have a unique ID, set via @synapse-id comment or directory name
E1.fixGuide:
1. Open content.md
2. Add <!-- @synapse-id: <derived-id> --> at the top
3. Or rename the directory to match

E2.title: ID does not match path
E2.fixGuide:
1. Check @synapse-id is correct
2. Use one-click fix to sync with path
3. Or rename the directory

E3.title: Missing title
E3.cause: Title is shown on the map and in search results
E3.fixGuide:
1. Open content.md
2. Add <!-- @synapse-title: <title> --> at the top
3. Or use one-click fix

E4.title: Missing type tag
E4.message: @synapse-tags must have at least one type: prefix
E4.cause: type: tags are used for categorization and filtering (e.g. type:note, type:ref)
E4.fixGuide:
1. Open @synapse-tags comment
2. Add type:note tag
3. Or use one-click fix

E5.title: Directory too deep
E5.cause: Deep nesting makes link maintenance harder
E5.fixGuide:
1. Move nested subdirectories to a shallower level
2. Or merge related entries

E6.title: Root-level .md file exists
E6.message: Root directory should not contain .md files directly
E6.cause: Root .md files should be wrapped in entries/<name>/ directory
E6.fixGuide:
1. Create entries/<basename>/ at root
2. Move .md in and rename to content.md
3. Or use one-click fix

E7.title: Reserved prefix directory
E7.cause: _ prefix directories are reserved for hidden/internal use
E7.fixGuide:
1. Rename the directory to remove _ prefix
2. Or move it outside the KB root

E9.title: User wrote system label
E9.cause: System labels are auto-added by rules, users should not write them manually
E9.fixGuide:
1. Remove that @synapse-labels entry
2. Or use one-click fix
